definitions.explanation: A type or format that emphasizes direct participation and personal experience rather than passive observation. Common in tourism, education, and marketing to describe activities where participants engage actively.

⟦{子供|こども}{向|む}け→子供向け：17933_kodomomuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体験型|たいけんがた}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

examples.english: This museum has many interactive exhibits where you can actually touch and operate things.

notes:
USAGE:
A pre-noun modifier using the pattern ～{型|がた} (type/style). Part of a productive word-formation pattern where {型|がた} indicates a category: ⟦{参加型|さんかがた}→参加型：24317_sankagata⟧ (participatory), ⟦{対話型|たいわがた}→対話型：21192_taiwagata⟧ (interactive/dialogue-based). Frequently used in tourism marketing and education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体験型|たいけんがた}⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧ (experiential tourism)
- {体験型|たいけんがた}⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ (experiential learning)
- {体験型|たいけんがた}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (hands-on facility)
- {体験型|たいけんがた}⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧ (interactive event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{参加型|さんかがた}→参加型：24317_sankagata⟧: participatory — emphasizes active participation
- ⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: experience — the base noun meaning a direct personal experience
